cards.name: Cat
facts: Cats are small domesticated mammals known for their agility and balance.
Most cats sleep for long hours each day to conserve energy.
A cat's whiskers help it sense nearby objects and judge tight spaces.

cards.name: Cow
facts: Cows are domesticated farm animals raised in many parts of the world.
They are herbivores and mainly eat grass, hay, and other plant-based food.
Cows are important in agriculture because they provide milk and support food production.

cards.name: Dog
facts: Dogs are domesticated mammals that have lived alongside humans for thousands of years.
A dog's sense of smell is much stronger than a human's.
Dogs communicate through body language, vocal sounds, and facial expressions.

cards.name: Baby Elephant
facts: Elephants are the largest land animals and are known for their long trunks.
An elephant's trunk is used for breathing, smelling, touching, and picking up objects.
Elephants live in social groups and are known for strong memory and communication.

cards.name: Mixue Snow King
facts: Mixue Snow King is the mascot of Mixue Ice Cream and Tea.
The character is designed with a crown, cape, and snowman-like appearance.
Brand mascots help create a strong visual identity and make products more memorable.

cards.name: Monkey
facts: Monkeys are primates known for their intelligence and ability to climb.
Many monkeys use their hands, feet, and tails to move through trees and hold objects.
They often live in groups and communicate using sounds, facial expressions, and movement.
